messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #4218 (render-cache) is blocked by a flaky smoke on canary. Build 9876 failed with `smoke_render_test` timeout, blocking our noon merge window. Can someone grab this?
jen: I saw that failure too. It's only reproing on canary shard7. Logs look like a timing-related assertion, not a deterministic crash. Link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/9876
ci-bot: build 9876 — smoke_render_test — FAILED (timeout after 120s) — test shard: shard7 — <@alex> reported.
samir: Quick hypothesis: the test occasionally hits a race when the background cache warmup takes longer on canary. Two options: 1) targeted rerun on shard7, 2) increase test timeout to 180s while we root-cause. I prefer targeted rerun first.
jen: Agree. I'll trigger a targeted rerun on shard7. Command: `buildkite rerun --job 9876 --shards 7`
maria: I can stand up a quick canary sanity run after the rerun if it goes green. Happy to take that at 15:00 PT.
liam: Heads-up — there is a canary rollout in progress until 14:30 PT. Avoid wide reruns that might hammer infra; shard-targeted is good.
alex: Cool. If rerun is green we can merge but let's timebox: merge by 16:00 PT today if we get 2 approvals and canary sanity passes. Need at least one eng + one reviewer.
jen: started rerun now. pinging when results in CI. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
buildkite-bot: Started targeted rerun for job 9876 (shard7). New build 9880 queued.
jen: quick log tail from the failing shard (from 9876):
```
[2026-03-18T12:11:02Z] INFO cache_warmup: 2.1s elapsed
[2026-03-18T12:13:59Z] WARN test_timeout: waiting for render to complete
[2026-03-18T12:14:02Z] ERROR smoke_render_test: timed out after 120s
```
samir: That looks like slow cache warmup + tight test timeout. If rerun flakes again we should consider bumping to 180s and file a follow-up to avoid blocking mergers.
maria: rerun green on 9880? I can kick a short canary check in ~5 mins.
buildkite-bot: Build 9880 — smoke_render_test — PASSED (shard7).
jen: nice — 9880 is green on shard7.
maria: did canary sanity: quick smoke across a subset — all good. no visible regressions.
liam: Since canary rollout still ongoing, let's wait for the current canary check to finish (eta ~10m) but +1 from me for merge after that.
alex: Thanks all. Tagging reviewers: @jen (code owner) and @samir (integration) — please leave your approvals when you can. Plan: merge <=16:00 PT if approvals + canary final check. :thumbsup:
jen: leaving approval now. approving in PR.
samir: leaving approval as well. will open a follow-up ticket to bump test timeout if we see more flakes.
alex: Merge scheduled for 15:55 PT. Will escalate if anything else pops up. Thanks team! :rocket:
